Case Study · Government · Booking Platform

Gir Online Booking System: five wildlife zones, one guided permit flow.

The only official permit booking platform for India's Asiatic Lion habitat — Gir National Park, Gujarat. Built for the Gujarat State Lion Conservation Society (GSLCS), it replaced a paper-heavy, counter-based process with a single guided flow across five wildlife destinations.

RoleUI UX Designer
CompanyGujarat Forest Dept. (GSLCS)
DomainGovernment · Tourism · Booking
ScopeEnd-to-end UX/UI, portal design
01 — The challenge

Booking a permit meant standing in line.

Every jungle safari, gypsy ride and nature-trail permit for Gir National Park was issued at a physical counter — a process that didn't scale for tourists, was hard on first-time or less digitally literate visitors, and gave the department no live view of demand across five separate destinations.

Paper-heavy

Counter-only booking

Every permit — jungle safari, gypsy ride, bus safari, nature trail — required an in-person queue, with no official online alternative.

Complex

A multi-step selection maze

Choosing a zone, date, vehicle type and slot involved a tangled process that needed to become predictable and guided instead.

Accessibility

Uneven digital literacy

Visitors ranged from tech-savvy tourists to first-time online bookers, so the flow had to work for both without extra friction.

02 — Approach

Three decisions that shaped the platform.

01

One booking wizard for five zones

Gir Jungle Safari, Devalia Park (Gypsy & Bus), Ambardi Safari Park, Girnar Nature Safari and Velavadar National Park all book through the same guided flow, instead of five separate processes.

02

A guided 4-step wizard replaces the maze

The multi-step permit selection process was simplified into four clear steps, reducing the drop-off points that came with the old counter-based flow.

03

Accounts, accessibility and mobile-first

SSO login and account management support repeat visitors, while a bilingual-ready, mobile-first layout — with a dedicated app-download CTA — keeps the flow usable across literacy levels and devices.

03 — Inside the platform

Five destinations, one guided flow.

Each zone kept its own permit type and vehicle options, unified under the same step-by-step booking experience — plus gallery, news & downloads, DO's & DON'Ts and contact modules for the full portal.

Zone 01

Gir Jungle Safari

Jeep safari permits into the core forest — the flagship Asiatic Lion experience.

Zone 02

Devalia Park

Gypsy and bus safari options in a fenced interpretation zone built for reliable lion sightings.

Zone 03

Ambardi Safari Park

A rehabilitated buffer-zone safari circuit near Devalia.

Zone 04

Girnar Nature Safari

Nature-trail permits around the Girnar hill range.

Zone 05

Velavadar National Park

Blackbuck grassland safari permits — the platform's fifth destination.
